purpose: Represent source-explicit historical and modern affricate environments without automatically inferring persistence of a phonological rule.

historical_source.citation: Merrill et al. 2020, El Diccionario Tarahumara–Alemán de Matthäus Steffel, §7.5.2 and Appendix 5
historical_source.analysis: <tsch> is associated with voiceless palatoalveolar [č], <ts> with a voiceless probably dentoalveolar affricate; the two are analyzed as allophones of one phoneme /č/.

modern_source.citation: Caballero 2022, A grammar of Choguita Rarámuri, Chapter 2 Phonology
modern_source.analysis: Choguita has phonemic alveo-palatal /tʃ/. Alveopalatal affricates may optionally depalatalize to alveolar [ts] before low central vowels; further deaffrication may occur in fast speech.

cross_source_hypotheses.label: low_central_environment_parallel
cross_source_hypotheses.historical_evidence: Initial <tsch> and <ts> are reported in free variation before a.
cross_source_hypotheses.modern_evidence: Choguita /tʃ/ optionally depalatalizes to [ts] before low central vowels, with a-examples.

cross_source_hypotheses.label: grasp_lexeme_three_source_alignment
cross_source_hypotheses.historical_evidence: Steffel/Merrill tschapí, phonetic čapí, gloss agarrar.
cross_source_hypotheses.modern_lexicographic_evidence: Rarámuri Digital RD-000656 Chapí 'Coger, agarrar; tomar; elegir'.
